claim_text: GOF/sufficiency + compound-LOF re-attack on pronephros TF-set induction. HONEST RESULT (causal-pruner HYPOTHESIS, human-gated): induction is SUBSTANTIALLY CLARIFIED but NOT resolved. The program is induced WITHIN the competent posterior intermediate mesoderm via an RA->osr1->wnt2b/pax2a/lhx1a cascade (osr1 = proximate TF node, downstream of RA per PMID:22129829, upstream of wnt2b per PMID:36359386). FGF (fgf8/fgf24, redundant) is NECESSARY for the posterior-mesoderm FIELD (compound-LOF blocks most posterior mesoderm, PMID:12925590) AND PROMOTES pronephric over blood/endothelial fate dose-dependently WITHIN that field (fgf8a OE increases / Fgf-block decreases pronephric precursors; Tbx16 attenuates Fgf to balance the choice — PMID:24008197/PMC3919442; DIRECTION verified against primary text by the audit). This is instructive fate-allocation within the competent field, NOT de-novo/ectopic induction and NOT the proximate TF-program node. Wnt (wnt8a) stays permissive/posteriorizing (field necessity); wnt2b acts downstream of osr1. SUFFICIENCY (single-signal ectopic induction from non-IM tissue) is NOT TESTED -- no GOF datum exists in these lenses (the GOF/ectopic EuropePMC queries were citation-sorted top-5 over 266-2741 hits and returned reviews; ZFIN/Alliance carries LOF-only annotations, 0 overexpression/ectopic records). Absence here is a gap_flag, NOT a demonstrated negative -- the same absence-of-evidence pattern the round-2 audit corrected.
